table.name: matches
table.purpose: One row per completed singles tennis match (WTA women's tour, 2013-2017), with tournament metadata and pre-match attributes of the winner and loser (ranking, seed, age, height, hand, country).

best_of.name: best_of
best_of.description: Maximum number of sets in the match; always 3 (best-of-three) in this data.

draw_size.name: draw_size
draw_size.description: Number of players in the tournament's main draw (e.g. 128 for Grand Slams, 64, 32, 8, 4).

loser_age.name: loser_age
loser_age.description: Age of the losing player at match time, in years (fractional, computed from birth date).

loser_entry.name: loser_entry
loser_entry.description: Entry type of the loser into the tournament (e.g. wildcard, qualifier); empty string for all rows here, i.e. direct entry.

loser_hand.name: loser_hand
loser_hand.description: Playing hand of the loser: R = right-handed, L = left-handed.

loser_ht.name: loser_ht
loser_ht.description: Height of the losing player, in centimeters (157-185).

loser_id.name: loser_id
loser_id.description: Identifier of the losing player; references players.player_id.

loser_ioc.name: loser_ioc
loser_ioc.description: IOC three-letter country code of the losing player (RUS, CZE, USA, ...).

loser_name.name: loser_name
loser_name.description: Full name of the losing player.

loser_rank.name: loser_rank
loser_rank.description: World ranking of the losing player at the time of the match (1 = best).

loser_rank_points.name: loser_rank_points
loser_rank_points.description: Ranking points of the losing player at the time of the match.

loser_seed.name: loser_seed
loser_seed.description: Tournament seed of the losing player (1-32); unseeded players appear to be stored as 0/blank in the source but here values are 1-32.

match_num.name: match_num
match_num.description: Match number within the tournament (ordering of matches in the draw); not unique across tournaments.

minutes.name: minutes
minutes.description: Duration of the match in minutes (0-199; 0 likely a walkover/retirement default).

round.name: round
round.description: Round of the match: F = final, SF = semifinal, QF = quarterfinal, R16/R32 = round of 16/32, RR = round robin.

score.name: score
score.description: Match score in sets, from the winner's perspective, with tiebreak points in parentheses (e.g. '6-4 6-7(4) 6-1').

surface.name: surface
surface.description: Court surface of the tournament: Hard, Clay, or Grass.

tourney_date.name: tourney_date
tourney_date.description: Start date of the tournament as YYYYMMDD integer (e31021-20170828).

tourney_id.name: tourney_id
tourney_id.description: Tournament identifier, typically year plus a code (e.g. '2017-M006', '2016-540'); format varies across sources.

tourney_level.name: tourney_level
tourney_level.description: Tournament tier code: I (Premier/International), G (Grand Slam), P (Premier), W (WTA Finals). Exact mapping of I vs P is plausible but not fully certain.

tourney_name.name: tourney_name
tourney_name.description: Name of the tournament (Indian Wells, Us Open, Wimbledon, ...).

winner_age.name: winner_age
winner_age.description: Age of the winning player at match time, in years (fractional).

winner_entry.name: winner_entry
winner_entry.description: Entry type of the winner into the tournament; empty string for all rows here, i.e. direct entry.

winner_hand.name: winner_hand
winner_hand.description: Playing hand of the winner: R = right-handed, L = left-handed.

winner_ht.name: winner_ht
winner_ht.description: Height of the winning player, in centimeters (159-185).

winner_id.name: winner_id
winner_id.description: Identifier of the winning player; references players.player_id.

winner_ioc.name: winner_ioc
winner_ioc.description: IOC three-letter country code of the winning player.

winner_name.name: winner_name
winner_name.description: Full name of the winning player.

winner_rank.name: winner_rank
winner_rank.description: World ranking of the winning player at the time of the match (1 = best).

winner_rank_points.name: winner_rank_points
winner_rank_points.description: Ranking points of the winning player at the time of the match.

winner_seed.name: winner_seed
winner_seed.description: Tournament seed of the winning player (1-30).

table.name: players
table.purpose: Master list of tennis players (mostly women, WTA-style IDs) with birth date, country, name parts, and playing hand.

birth_date.name: birth_date
birth_date.description: Player's date of birth as YYYYMMDD (stored as text/union; empty string when unknown).

country_code.name: country_code
country_code.description: Three-letter country/IOC-style code of the player's nationality (USA, ITA, ESP, ...; includes historical codes like FRG).

first_name.name: first_name
first_name.description: Player's first (given) name(s); may include multiple given names.

hand.name: hand
hand.description: Playing hand: R = right, L = left, U = unknown, empty = missing.

last_name.name: last_name
last_name.description: Player's last (family) name; may be compound (e.g. 'Van Renterghem', 'Delgado Valero').

player_id.name: player_id
player_id.description: Unique player identifier (primary key); referenced by matches.winner_id and matches.loser_id.

table.name: rankings
table.purpose: Historical world rankings snapshots for tennis players (ATP/WTA-style): each row is a player's rank, ranking points, and tournaments played as of a weekly ranking date, from 1987 to 2017.

player_id.name: player_id
player_id.description: Identifier of the ranked player; references the players table (join not detected but values are player codes like 200009, 201305). Stored as text despite numeric-looking values.

ranking.name: ranking
ranking.description: The player's world ranking position on the ranking date; 1 = best. Ranges 1-1507.

ranking_date.name: ranking_date
ranking_date.description: Date of the ranking snapshot, encoded as YYYYMMDD integer (e.g. 20160307 = 2016-03-07). Spans 1987-01-19 to 2017-09-11, roughly weekly.

ranking_points.name: ranking_points
ranking_points.description: Ranking points accumulated by the player on that date (0 to 13615). Low values dominate because most ranked players have few points.

tours.name: tours
tours.description: Number of tournaments (tour events) counted toward the player's ranking on that date; 0-41.
